records.text: From a license valid through October 24, 2020 and New York's two-year license term, Candace Owens inferred that Erika Kirk received her real-estate license on October 24, 2018.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This is a snapshot. You can see it says this real estate license is valid until October 24th, 2020. In New York, your real estate license lasts for two years. Think of it like a driver's license. You have to get that license renewed. And it's every two years. So if it expired in October 24, 2020, that means that she received her real estate license, we can assume, on October 24, 2018.

verification.notes: The displayed license record gives an October 24, 2020 expiration, and New York's Department of State says a salesperson license term is two years. That supports Owens's October 24, 2018 inference, although an expiration date alone does not prove whether a prior issuance or reissuance occurred.
